title: Satori business app record page
description: Writes a version 2 view layout for a document type, one card per schema, from the server's content model, and has the package's component contribute it.

package.description: The app definition package, as a path from the workspace root, such as business-apps/packages/acme-contracts.

type.description: The document type the record page is for, as the content model names it.

model.description: The content model, a file `npm run app-package:model` exported: { doctypes, facets, schemas }. Give this or modelServer.

modelServer.description: Read the content model live instead, from this Nuxeo, such as http://localhost:8080/nuxeo, with NUXEO_USER and NUXEO_PASS from the environment. HTTPS, or HTTP to this machine only.

schemas.description: The schemas to show, one card each, in order, separated by commas. Defaults to the type's schemas but Nuxeo's own (common, dublincore, uid, file, files, facetedTag, relatedtext).

columns.description: How many columns the cards fill, 1 to 3. Defaults to 2, or 1 for a single card.

force.description: Write the layout again if the type already has one. Its labels keep the text labels/en.json has.
